# zerops_projects (Data Source)

Lists projects with client-side status filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zerops_projects" "example" {
  name_contains = "app"
  statuses      = ["ACTIVE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Filter project names by substring.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider organization.
- `statuses` (Set of String) Raw statuses filtered client-side; empty means all.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resolved organization ID.
- `projects` (Attributes List) Matching projects sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Id.
- `location` (String) Location.
- `mode` (String) Mode.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `tags` (Set of String) Full project tags.
